question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given phrase.

Hit the sack
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Hit the sack"** means:

 
 
• English Meaning: To go to bed or to go to sleep. (सोने के लिए जाना)
 
• **Example: **After a long day at work, I decided ***t****o hit the sack *tearly.
 
 
 
• **"Going to sleep"** refers to the act of falling asleep. (सोना)
 
 
• **Example: **Feeling exhausted, she decided to ***go to sleep*** immediately after dinner.
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is **Going to sleep**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Running on the beach** (समुद्र तट पर दौड़ना): Engaging in a run or jog along the beach.

 
 
• **Example:** She loves** *running on the beac*h **every morning to stay fit.
 
 
 
• **Cracking the exams** (परीक्षाओं को पास करना): Successfully passing exams.
 
 
• **Example:** He spent months studying and finally ***cracked the exams.***
 
 
 
• **Making money quickly** (जल्दी पैसा कमाना): Earning money in a short amount of time.
 
 
• **Example:** Many people are looking for ways to ***make money quickly*** through online businesses.
